The '''DEMP Ionization Blast Rocket''' was an anti-droid [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] for use in wrist rocket launchers such as the [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]].
